correctness.rationale: Exact generator recurrence and independently integrated stationary reset-age Brownian-angle correlations yield identical first three moments. Their centered third moment factors into \(p[A(r)+p^2B(r)]\). Descartes’ sign count gives the sole positive root of Q; a direct derivative identity and a global coefficient bound \(P(r)<0\) on \(0<r\le2\) prove the unique sign crossover for all p,r>0. The actual verify.py program checks the rational identities and polynomial certificates.

originality.rationale: The same-model source evaluates directional means, second moments, and radial fourth-order kurtosis; it does not state a longitudinal third-central-moment reset-rate uniqueness theorem. Highly relevant orientation-only skewness, distributed-reset OU, and untrapped jointly reset ABP papers were read and have different processes/statements. Actual research-record and literature searches found no equivalent or dominating theorem; general moment tools are credited as prior.
residual_risks: The published parent paper derives a general moment generator, so the new third-cumulant expression is a calculational consequence of established machinery. The originality claim is restricted to its evaluated exact expression and sharp globally unique reset-rate sign transition.
It is possible an undiscovered general theorem about active Brownian third cumulants or resetting could imply the sign frontier; searches are not a formal proof of uniqueness in the literature.
The parameter slice with equal angular and trap relaxation is the complete domain of this theorem; no general-trap-strength classification is claimed.
Independent scientific audit and definitive publication-priority review have not been performed.

value.rationale: A stationary signed third-cumulant phase boundary is a physically meaningful odd-moment diagnostic absent from radial kurtosis. Matched rotational and trap relaxation is an intrinsic equal-timescale regime, and the strict universal rate interval together with one crossover for every positive activity and monotone threshold activity-dependence is a nontrivial complete structural classification, rather than an arbitrary isolated value.
